BiblicalUsage: Sichah is meditation, devotion, the prayer that lingers. Eliphaz accuses Job of casting off fear and restraining it before God, while the psalmist answers with delight: O how I love Thy law, it is my meditation all the day, and I have more understanding than all my teachers, for Thy testimonies are my meditation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe meditation is the difference between knowing the law and loving it. Eliphaz said Job had restrained it, and the psalmist says it filled his whole day, and I hold that the law I love is the law that teaches me.
